infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: The Remote Viewer uses on-device speech recognition so you can dictate instead of typing. Speech is not sent to TRV servers.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is used only for optional voice input and listen sessions you start. You can use text only.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is used only when you enable Sight. Frames stay on device and are not uploaded to TRV servers.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow The Remote Viewer to use the microphone for optional voice input.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow The Remote Viewer to use speech recognition for optional dictation. Speech is not sent to TRV servers.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow The Remote Viewer to use the camera only when you enable Sight. Frames are not uploaded to TRV servers.
